vscode-ibmi-bob.configuration.general.ma: Maximum number of rows to fetch when Bob executes SQL. When a query has more rows to return, Bob will restrict itself to this limit to avoid overloading the context window. If needed, Bob will fetch more rows afterwards if needed
vscode-ibmi-bob.configuration.guardrails: When enabled, Bob will require CL commands to be library-qualified when using the `execute_cl_command` tool. If a command is not library-qualified, Bob will query `QSYS2.COMMAND_INFO` to find the command library and provide suggestions.

List of SQL statement types (e.g., 'Create', 'Alter', or 'Begin') that Bob is NOT allowed to execute without additional user confirmation when using the `run_sql_statement` tool. This setting is a layer of security that is separate from Bob's general auto approval settings.
